Description

whenever i turn selfie expressions on, vrc overrides my camera and my cam turns black/purple-ish to the point where you can only see shadows and nothing is recognizable. before i start the game, my camera works just fine and as soon as i start vrc, it works for about ten seconds, then my avatar freezes and then selfie expressions don't work anymore because my camera stopped working properly. i got my device checked by windows and they told me the issue is not with my device. makes sense since i only experience this with selfie expressions...

Reproduction Steps

genuinely don't know. it happens as soon as i turn selfie expressions on but since it's not really an issue within the game but because of the game, i don't really know

Details

- Category: Performance

- Frequency: Always
